newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis sees French 1997 growth at least 2.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis sees French 1997 growth at least 2.3 pct.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis repeated on Wednesday that he considered the government's official forecast of 2.3 percent gross domestic product growth for 1997 to be a minimum threshold.
He said the recent rise in the dollar would help France exceed the forecast.
The dollar rise "puts us in an encouraging context and 2.3 percent growth is a minimum," Arthuis told reporters.
